cells.quote: Owing to the mediating role of linguistic competence and selective attention, children with language or attention disorders are still more impaired than normally developing children by noise in speech perception tasks (Geffner et al., 1996; Ziegler et al., 2005, 2009 ).
cells.note: The review attributes the finding to linguistic competence and selective attention; the designs of the cited studies are not described in the review.
